title: Tab name pool contract
description: The pool the worker and the browser dialogs both name new tabs from. The name pattern is the one plan_mode.go's auto-title regex accepts, so a name that fails it here would silently disable plan-mode auto-rename instead of failing the build. The 8-character cap keeps a tab title short. Rules the schema CANNOT express -- friendly form only, predictable pronunciation, distinct at a glance, no identity marker -- live in the contract's _rules field and are applied by a reviewer.
